title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. translated_title: AscendGYM：面向昇腾NPU真实工作负载的成本感知算子优化基准
translated_abstract: 算子优化对于在昇腾NPU上高效进行大语言模型（LLM）训练和推理至关重要。现有的昇腾算子基准主要关注算子生成，较少关注智能体在来自真实工作负载的输入配置下优化现有实现的能力。为满足这一需求，我们提出了AscendGYM，这是一个基准测试，其初始套件包含48个算子，分为三个难度级别。每个算子都配有测试用例，其数据类型和张量形状均收集自真实的训练和推理任务。因此，在AscendGYM上取得的性能提升可以直接映射到相应的工作负载。在可用性方面，AscendGYM支持两种评估模式：模型评估和模型-框架评估，既可以衡量经过训练的模型，也可以衡量自定义智能体的算子优化能力。它提供了一个完整的执行环境……
tldr: 提出AscendGYM——首个面向昇腾NPU真实工作负载的成本感知算子优化基准，其48个算子的测试数据类型与张量形状均来自真实训练和推理任务，并支持模型评估与模型-框架评估两种模式来衡量智能体的算子优化能力。
en_tdlr: AscendGYM is a cost-aware kernel optimization benchmark for Ascend NPUs, comprising 48 kernels across three difficulty levels with test cases drawn from real-world training and inference workloads, and supporting both model evaluation and model-harness evaluation modes.
